raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 12 was delivered twice (02:00 and 05:00). The 05:00 re-delivery repeats all 345 rows with txn_ts as epoch milliseconds, which breaks the TIMESTAMP cast. It also causes 345 duplicate txn_ids (5320 rows vs 4975 distinct). The epoch value 1768543211000 equals 2026-01-16 06:00:11 UTC, the same as the original copy, so parsing both formats and deduplicating by txn_id gives the correct data.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.85,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH parsed AS (SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, status, ingest_ts, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]{13}$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts FROM raw_transactions), dedup AS (SELECT * FROM parsed QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC) = 1) SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM dedup WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
